name: create_task
description: Create a background task and immediately return its ID. Include goal, context, constraints and deliverables in text. Interpret the applicable AGENTS.md routing rules semantically using available configured Providers and models. Explicit current-task choices take precedence; otherwise leave unmatched work on existing defaults. Never silently substitute an unavailable preferred executor. Create a task for new work. To continue existing work, send owner guidance to that task with send_message; this also reopens archived tasks in their original workspace. Runtime prepares the workspace before the Worker starts. For Git feature development select workspace.kind=worktree and its source project_dir; reuse an existing worktree or explicitly requested in-place project with kind=directory. Without a project use temporary (the default). Runtime refreshes the remote base and creates managed worktrees; do not ask the Worker to choose directories, pull the base or create its own worktree. Keep workspace setup metadata out of the Worker text; the Worker receives its cwd. Omitted executor, link_id and target retain ordinary task execution. executor=codex directly delegates a task to a Codex node without a Codex assistant; one task owns one session and approval requests return to this assistant. Assistant messages carry no approval authority. To delegate to a linked node, provide its link_id and optionally target from list_assistants; the receiver uses its persisted default assistant when target is omitted. Linked nodes own their models, permissions, credentials and workspaces. Accepted work remains bound to the chosen receiver assistant. Files are not copied from other workspaces. Tool calls use the receiving node’s local authorization; completion closes only this Task's processes and sessions while retaining files. The text must contain a concise title on its first line AND complete instructions on following lines. A title-only brief is rejected. Preserve the user's exact commands and constraints; workers do not see the chat.

profile.description: Configured Provider connection Profile ID chosen autonomously for this task. Omit to use the invoking assistant’s active configuration. No user allowlist or route confirmation is needed.

desktop.description: Native desktop automation is currently unsupported. Independent headless browser automation does not require desktop=true.

selection_reason.description: Concise creation-time reason for the chosen executor; do not claim certainty for ambiguous work.

skills.description: Global skill names to include in this task. Omitted or empty loads no global skills. Project skills are always discovered independently.

model.description: Concrete model ID supported by the selected Provider. Omitted uses that Provider’s default model; with no Provider selection, uses the invoking assistant’s active model.

workspace.description: Destination-local workspace intent. Feature development in a Git project defaults to worktree; explicit reuse/in-place overrides it. Runtime generates and binds the actual path.

project_dir.description: Existing absolute source project path on the selected execution machine; omit for temporary.

remote.description: Optional Git remote; otherwise origin or the sole remote.

base.description: Optional remote base branch; otherwise discover the remote default branch.

branch.description: Optional new feature branch; otherwise Runtime generates a unique codex/ branch.

commit.description: Optional exact pinned commit instead of updating a base branch.

link_id.description: Agent Link connection ID from list_execution_targets. Omit for local execution.

target.description: Explicit receiving assistant address from list_assistants. Omit to use the receiving node’s persisted default.

executor.description: Explicit Codex task execution. Creates one independent Codex session per task, with approvals in this assistant. Omit to retain ordinary task execution. Use link_id to select a Codex node when multiple are connected; do not supply an assistant target.

name: list_tasks
description: Search task metadata by state and title/ID. Defaults to active tasks, 10 per page; archived tasks keep complete/cancelled status. Use attention for failed/interrupted, archived to find past results, all only with a relevant query. Follow next_offset only when needed; no polling.

phase.description: Exact execution status; overrides scope when provided

q.description: Case-insensitive title or task ID substring

name: get_task
description: Read recent results and execution state of a task.

name: set_task_dispositions
description: Set archive decisions for 1–8 ended Tasks in one atomic batch. archived=true archives a Task; false retains it for follow-up. Run completion does not archive automatically. Supply the current run_id from task metadata or the result event and a concise reason. Pending input or a newer/running run rejects stale decisions. Archiving retains context and workspace; worktree contents do not constrain this operation. During background result processing, only runs in the delivered batch can be changed.

name: send_message
description: Send a durable message to a Task or assistant using its address and the message text. Runtime binds the real sender, message provenance and reply linkage automatically. Active Tasks receive owner guidance or peer reference at a model boundary. Owner guidance to an ended Task reopens the same Task and starts a new run with retained context and workspace. Peer references never restart ended Tasks. Returns acceptance, never execution completion. Do not send task completion yourself: Runtime reports final results automatically.

name: interrupt
description: Interrupt current work while retaining task/session/files and pending guidance. Does not replay interrupted input or automatically resume. Running work retains capacity until cleanup is confirmed; continue later by sending new owner guidance to the same Task. Completed task results remain complete.

name: cancel_task
description: Abandon a task: stop current execution, discard pending guidance and mark cancelled after confirmed cleanup. Retains history and files; cancelled tasks appear in Archived. Use interrupt to preserve guidance for later continuation. Completed results remain complete.

name: list_schedules
description: List scheduled plans (metadata only). Filter enabled/paused/all; use pagination.

name: get_schedule
description: Read a schedule definition and paginated execution history.

name: manage_schedule
description: Create/update/pause/resume/delete/run a persistent schedule. Pausing/deleting prevents future triggers and does not cancel current work. An immediate run is non-overlapping. Calendar recurrence uses five-field Cron. Omitted timezone defaults to the owning Control system IANA zone on create; updates preserve the saved zone. Saved zones stay fixed when the system zone changes. Explicit timezone overrides the default. Control triggers a new task on the saved machine; each dispatch reads that machine's current execution policy. Omit machine_id on update to preserve the selected machine. Creation/update requires spec. Deletion is soft and keeps execution history.

timezone.description: Optional IANA name. Defaults to owning Control system zone at creation, saved thereafter; omitted on update preserves the saved zone.

profile.description: Configured Provider Profile ID chosen autonomously. Omit to snapshot the owning assistant’s configuration at each trigger.

desktop.description: Native desktop automation is currently unsupported. Independent headless browser automation does not require desktop=true.

machine_id.description: Machine to run on. Each occurrence reads its current execution policy and creates a fresh Task. Omit on update to retain the machine.

model.description: Concrete model supported by the selected configured Provider.

cron.description: cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Lists, ranges, steps, month/weekday names supported; Sunday=0. Restricted DOM and DOW match either. No seconds, macros, ?, L, W or #. Example: 0 8-20 * * * runs hourly 08:00 through 20:00. DST gaps skipped; repeated wall times run once at the earlier instant.

name: list_execution_targets
description: List this autonomous node and its Agent Link connections, provided assistants and advertised capabilities. Remote nodes own execution and authorization. No Control/Runner enrollment is required.

name: list_assistants
description: List addressable assistants in this Control and Spaces connected through the App relay. A listed remote assistant may be offline. Does not start work.

name: get_model_catalog
description: Discover configured Provider profiles with offset/limit, or supply profile for its model facts. models and configured_models are separately paginated with the same offset/limit and report their totals.
